class.name: VertexAIAssistant
class.brief_description: Vertex AI assistant architecture for project understanding and assisted editing.
class.description: VertexAIAssistant maintains a registry of named commands, gathers context (project structure, scripts, scenes, shaders, assets, errors, logs, profiler/perf results) and dispatches commands through a pluggable backend Callable. Destructive commands require an explicit confirmation: [method request] returns a pending action with a token that must be passed to [method confirm] before execution. The engine makes no network calls; a real LLM is wired in by setting [member backend]. Built-in commands (create_player, create_scene, fix_error, optimize_project, reduce_memory_usage, explain_node, create_animation, create_ui, optimize_shader) return structured plans rather than mutating files directly.

method.name: confirm
method.description: Confirms and executes a pending destructive command identified by the token returned from [method request]. Returns [code]{"executed": bool, "result": Variant, "command": String}[/code].

method.name: get_command
method.description: Returns the command registered under the given name, or null.

method.name: has_command
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a command with the given name is registered.

method.name: list_commands
method.description: Returns an array of dictionaries describing all registered commands.

method.name: push_error_entry
method.description: Adds an entry to the error log so the assistant can reason over it.

method.name: request
method.description: Requests execution of a command. If the command is destructive, returns [code]{"needs_confirmation": true, "token": int, "message": String}[/code]; otherwise executes immediately and returns [code]{"needs_confirmation": false, "result": Variant, "message": "ok"}[/code].

method.name: set_backend
method.description: Sets the pluggable backend Callable invoked before command execution, receiving a dictionary with the command name and gathered context.

signal.name: command_executed
signal.description: Emitted when a command finishes executing.

signal.name: command_requested
signal.description: Emitted when a command is requested.

signal.name: confirmation_required
signal.description: Emitted when a destructive command needs confirmation.
